import re

text = """Our support agent will [assist] you with account access issues.
If you [cannot] sign in, we will [guide] you through resetting your password."""

synonyms = {
    "assist": "aid",
    "cannot": "are unable to",
    "guide": "walk you through",
}

def replace_bracketed(text, mapping):
    def repl(match):
        word = match.group(1)
        return mapping.get(word, word)  # fallback: keep original if not found
    return re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]", repl, text)

print(replace_bracketed(text, synonyms))
